field_principles.codegen_corrigendum_ready: True only after SOTA generation, sandbox execution, and methodology gates complete.
field_principles.flagged_adversarial: True for blocked or methodology-unsafe artifacts; false for corrected rows.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal verdict; blocked verdicts do not report headline rates.
field_principles.legacy_smoke_only: True only when no mandated SOTA GGUF is cached, so headline metrics stay null.
field_principles.model_specs: Mandated local GGUF model specs considered for headline generation.
field_principles.models_used: HF IDs actually used for candidate generation.
field_principles.per_task_results: One row per selected task, including the k-length pass vector.
field_principles.random_seed: Top-level experiment seed required by the corrigendum.
field_principles.random_seeds_used: Every per-candidate seed sent to the generation backend.
field_principles.raw_response_dir: Directory containing raw model responses, one file per candidate.

honest_verdict: complete: SOTA code-generation corrigendum executed with pass@1=0.5000 and pass@k=1.0000
methodology_note: pass@1 and pass@k are distinct metrics: pass@1 counts only the first candidate for a task, while pass@k counts whether any of the k bounded candidates for the same task passes the executable tests. Equal aggregate values are not accepted silently; when they occur, every task must explain whether candidate 0 already passed or no candidate in the bounded set passed.
selection_rule: Select the first N eligible rows in manifest order for each of MBPP and HumanEval, then generate exactly k candidates per task using consecutive candidate seeds from top-level random_seed=2910.
